cards.action: I architected a framework where AI models are pluggable modules, allowing us to deploy new models like DeepSeek R1 within 24 hours. I also directed the creation of anura, an OpenAI-compatible gateway with automated LiteLLM failover to ensure service stability.
cards.result: This provided drop-in compatibility with LangChain and Autonolas agents. If a decentralized GPU node fails, the failover layer transparently reroutes requests to redundant endpoints without disconnecting the client.

cards.her_role: built, led and directed; AI agents wrote the code under my direction
cards.situation: Credentials were present in real repos, so a secret scan before upload was mandatory. On the pilot, the scan of the HTML that would be uploaded found 15 findings, but the same content as raw text found 47.
cards.task: Find why the scanner under-reported, and make sure no secret reached the index.
cards.action: Traced it to HTML entity escaping, which hid the credentials from gitleaks. The scanner was changed to scan the unescaped raw text, and the rule became: scan both copies and require both clean. Every flagged document was dropped and recorded, then re-scanned to zero. An automated PR review then found five fail-open paths, where a failure still reported success: a failed import batch recorded as finished, a pagination error read as end of list, a crashed verification scan read as zero findings, failed clones not failing the harvest, and an existing search app not checked for its stores. All were fixed, and reconcile now checks the manifest. A 403 on the new project looked like a missing role but was IAM propagation; a retry returned 200 and it was recorded as a field finding. I built and led it, directing AI agents that wrote the code; I set the outcome, the gates and the decisions.
cards.result: On the full harvest the scan found 483 findings; 217 documents were dropped, the re-scan came back at 0, and 16,555 clean documents were uploaded.
cards.metric: Pilot scan: 15 findings on the HTML copy vs 47 on raw text; full run 483 findings, 217 documents dropped, re-scan 0.
